zh.title: macOS 新客户端连接修复与开放注册
items: 修复 macOS 端“连接新客户端”因 SPAKE2 P-256 公共 share 长度校验错误而立即失败的问题。
增加分阶段、本机脱敏诊断日志，覆盖输入校验、加密 vault、sidecar、远程确认与 Relay 重连。
Relayune 现在支持未预先列入白名单的邮箱完成验证并注册。

en.title: macOS new-client pairing fix and open registration
items: Fixed an SPAKE2 P-256 public-share length validation error that caused Connect New Client to fail immediately on macOS.
Added staged, locally redacted diagnostics for input validation, the encrypted vault, sidecar startup, remote confirmation, and Relay reconnection.
Relayune now lets email addresses that were not pre-approved complete verification and register.
